analysis_options.entrypoint: direct locked-signature seeding (FuncProto::setPieces lock tail, fspec.cc:3843-3852) plus one ActionPrototypeWarnings apply (coreaction.cc:4886-4936); no full decompilation pipeline
analysis_options.observation: per case: model identity line (name/unknown/printInDecl/hasModel/extrapop/modelExtraPop/three locks/param count/return size+storage), per-parameter storage lines (register@offset, size, typelock), and the filed warning headers read back from the architecture comment database; SCHEMA/ARCH_DEFAULT/UNKNOWN_PRE/UNKNOWN_POST boundary lines around the cases; pointer values and allocation identities never printed
analysis_options.prestate: production x86-64-gcc.cspec loaded through BfdArchitecture on the Ghidra side / the SpecQuery+parse_compiler_config composition on the Rugra side; four Funcdata carriers (free PLT thunk, __ctype_b_loc PLT thunk, main_init DWARF void, GetStr DWARF parameterized) each with the defaultfp-bound carrier FuncProto before the front-end adapter runs

architecture: x86:LE:64:default (SLEIGH x86-64, BfdArchitecture production cspec load)

coverage.dwarf_parameterized_keeps_resolved_model: GetStr void(char**,char*) keeps the resolved default model: no warning line, model name not 'unknown', no locks
coverage.dwarf_void_pins_unknown: main_init 4-byte-return 0-param DWARF entry pins the unknown model with all three locks and files the warning
coverage.generic_clib_plt_pins_unknown: free void(void*) and __ctype_b_loc ushort**() lock the unknown calling convention with the exact golden warning text
coverage.unknown_identity_semantics: UNKNOWN_PRE/POST: reserved 'unknown' name absent from the compiler-spec registry before, then materialized with isUnknown=1, printInDecl=0, default-cloned extrapop, behavior shared with the carrier's default model

ghidra_side: createUnknownModel (architecture.cc:1159-1166) for the reserved 'unknown' name (exactly what FuncProto::decode runs for an unrecognized ATTRIB_MODEL, fspec.cc:4690-4698), FuncProto::setPieces lock tail, Scope::addFunction ctor chain, real ActionPrototypeWarnings apply, warning headers read back from the architecture comment database

input_manifest.canonicalization: the bilateral projection is the ordered stdout stream; the oracle-side pin is expected_stdout_sha256 over the full stream, the comparand pins are the file sha256s in sha256/comparand_sha256
cases: PLT_FREE: generic_clib locked signature void(void*) on a PLT thunk, unknown calling convention
PLT_CTYPE: generic_clib void-list entry ushort**(), unknown calling convention, locked void input
DWARF_VOID: main_init @0x4960 curl DWARF void signature (4-byte return, 0 params)
DWARF_PARAMS: GetStr @0x36d0 curl DWARF parameterized, keeps the resolved model

known_divergences: R1 (by construction, not projected): Rugra represents the unknown model as the calling_convention string sentinel plus the shared default-model Arc (fspec.rs is_model_unknown / shares_model_with) instead of Ghidra's registered UnknownProtoModel object; behavior identical (extrapop/effects/param ranges follow default) but pointer identity (hasMatchingModel(defaultfp)) differs and is therefore not projected

R2 (normalized on both sides): void-return output storage prints 'none' (Ghidra leaves the void output address invalid; Rugra's output_storage carries a legacy (ram,0) placeholder - zero-size outputs have no storage semantically)

R3 (not projected here, covered by COREACTION-FUNCPARAMNAMES-RECOMMEND-0001 and the debugproto unit tests): NAME_LOCKED propagation; PrototypePieces has no namelock field so the Ghidra setPieces path cannot set it
notes: PLTSTUB-WARNLOSS-0001 seeding-layer half; B2 permanent lock of the sowing-layer unknown-convention identity (the callers' own E2E observables, 51/51 warnings with exact golden spelling and placement, are gated by the curl differential).
